title: Hayfoot! Strawfoot!
html_source: According to americanheritage.com, the martial call ‘Hayfoot! Strawfoot!’ derives from a mnemonic device contrived by American Civil War sergeants in order to teach their (grossly) under-educated recruits to differentiate their left foot from their right. After binding a little wisp of hay to their men’s left boots, and a bit of straw to their right boots, they would use the call as a substitute for the more common ‘Left! Right! Left! Right!’
